verdict.rationale: Devin supports trigger-driven autonomous maintenance: Auto-Fix responds to review comments and iterates on CI failures without a human in the loop, CI/CD integration responds to static-analysis findings, and Slack/Teams tagging and the API can launch sessions. Cloud VMs let work continue unattended, and the MCP server exposes a scheduling capability. Community reports that runs need periodic human checking temper confidence but do not contradict the documented features. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of schedule configuration (cron-style recurring runs), and independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled or triggered runs working unattended.
